decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer is a core next-generation platform that sits close to the established offer, so it likely meets aspiration levels and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The numbering software module adds value to the established inline printers at low carrying cost and supports the firm's serialization strategy, so slack easily covers it.

The coder for non-absorbent surfaces was only mentioned, not featured, but it extends the core ink and printer expertise into a niche that consumables sales can sustain, so there is little reason to drop it.
The CodeScan app is a cheap successor to PharmaScan that supports traceability, but free apps are often consolidated or replaced, so there is a moderate risk of dropping it.
Inline code verification fits directly with the move toward end-to-end traceability and compliance, so performance relative to strategic aspirations favors keeping it.
The layout design software was shown on the home page and is integral to common operation across systems, making it a core enabler rather than a drop candidate.
